notes.title: NEW LANGUAGES – FROM 1 TO SWEET 16
notes.content:
[h1]Ahoy, fellow sardines![/h1]
We have some thrilling news from the depths of the fish machine.

[i]How Fish Is Made[/i] is now out to swimming in new linguistic waters. Whether you’re navigating the eerie corridors of the factory or facing existential dilemmas, now you can experience it all in a variety of new languages! No matter if you’re making friends or pushing them into despair — you can do it all without losing any of the oily-sardine flavor. 

To celebrate the discovery of a new can of Linguis-tuna together with Critical Reflex we've prepared a brand-new trailer that’s sure to make you squirm like a freshly-caught fish: 

[previewyoutube=pHuZ_U9aDEI;full]How Fish Is Made — Trailer[/previewyoutube]

And that’s not all! [i]The Last One and Then Another[/i] expansion was also fully localized. Find out what happens to those who want to absorb everything by escaping from the labyrinths of the machine.
[h2]Changes in this update:[/h2][list]
[*] New available languages: Brazilian, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish, Spanish (LATAM), Traditional Chinese, Turkish, Ukrainian.
[*] Minor bug fixes. [/list]In case you somehow missed it ([i]fat chance! but who knows?[/i]), and if you’ve already navigated the eerie corridors of the fish factory in [i]How Fish Is Made[/i] and made your sardine-like choices, perhaps you’re ready for something more... cosmic. [i]Mouthwashing[/i] delivers a wild ride aboard a doomed freighter, where the air is thin, hope is thinner, and survival is anything but certain…

[spoiler]Psst! If you played and liked it, cast your vote for Mouthwashing as Outstanding Story-Rich Game in the Steam Awards! Make a true sardine choice! Click [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/2024]here[/url] to vote.[/spoiler]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475490/Mouthwashing/
Have you ever wanted to discuss the philosophy of sardine decision-making? Or maybe debate the best way to deal with your crewmates when food runs low? Explore strange new worlds, survive catastrophic events, or just swap memes and horror stories? If your answer to any of these is yes, join us on Discord!
Thanks once again for all your love and support. We hope you’re ready to dive back into the strange world of [i]How Fish Is Made[/i].
Wrong Organ and Critical Reflex

notes.title: Mouthwashing Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
[b]Mouthwashing is our newest title[/b] we've been cooking up for a while now. 

It's a [b]narrative driven first-person horror game[/b] following a dying spaceship crew, as they deal with addiction, desperation, and survival in a hapless situation. 

We're happy to announce that [b]You can play the demo for it now![/b]

[b]You can check it out here:[/b]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2475490/Mouthwashing/

Please let us know what you think of it! Thanks for all your support since [i]How Fish is Made[/i] released.

notes.title: Small Patch
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed volume issues.
[*] Added a "Reset position" button in the pause menu.
[*] Fixed multiple spots where the player could get stuck.
[*] Improved camera behaviour when talking to NPC's.
[*] Player can no longer reach the Mouthwash room before having entered the grinder hole.
[/list]

notes.title: Thank You for 85,000 Sales!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41718902/e2038bf572cdb12adb292f873d3809ca6e6674c8.png[/img]

[b]Hello Friend-Os![/b]

We wanted to take a moment to express our gratitude about how many people have tried and enjoyed this silly little sardine game. We've seen YouTube playthroughs, livestreams and even analysis videos which have all been a great joy to watch! It has far exceeded what we thought our game could accomplish. 

A big [b]THANK YOU[/b] to everyone who experienced the game and engaged with the weird story. Hope it inspires more oily filth like it!

We're currently back in the kitchen working on our next project, so follow us at [b]@byKASURAGA[/b] on Twitter for updates.

Thank you again!

[b]Big Love,
Johanna, Jeffrey & Martin[/b]
